dispositions.after: Deduplication in this particular sample does not introduce the unresolved reuse, which already existed.

dispositions.tag: The parser-function argument supplied é name and literal accented raw-ref name are distinct in this native response.
dispositions.group0: The r g argument selects a group containing literal entity text. A raw collector whose group contains an HTML entity decodes that entity and does not establish the same group here.
